overrides.reason: the demo only showed rank 1, so every rank displayed rank 1's value; audit 2026-09-15 against sim/hunter/aspects.go: only the proc chance grows with points, as in the Classic Improved Aspect of the Hawk (talent 1382) this talent is built from. The earlier revision multiplied every slot by the rank, which promised +150% attack speed for 60 sec at 5/5 and left the picker reading a scaling the sim never applied. The 2% per rank is still extrapolated from the one observed tooltip.

the demo only showed rank 1, so every rank displayed rank 1's value; rank 2 is the community talent calculator's linear extrapolation of that tooltip, which is rebuilt from the same BlizzCon footage and so corroborates the assumption rather than confirming it. Mend Pet is not modelled, so the sim has nothing to check it against.

beta client 1.60.1.69893: the proc chance curve is 50/100 (440529 effect 2), not the demo's 30 extrapolated to 60; the cost cut is 30/60 and the buff (1242688) is 50% for 30 sec at both ranks.
